# GetResponse
> GetResponse is an all-in-one marketing platform that helps businesses grow, engage their audiences, and monetize their expertise through email marketing, marketing automation, ecommerce, and content monetization.
GetResponse helps businesses acquire, engage, and monetize their audience through email campaigns, automation workflows, landing pages, signup forms, websites, webinars, transactional messaging, SMS, web push notifications, ecommerce tools, AI-powered content creation, and 170+ integrations with third-party services and ecommerce platforms.
Developers can integrate with GetResponse using the REST API and official SDKs to automate marketing workflows and build custom applications. Additional AI-focused integration resources, including an MCP server, are planned and will be added to this document as they become publicly available.
This document is the primary entry point for AI agents exploring GetResponse. It links to the most relevant developer documentation, product documentation, pricing information, SDKs, and other AI-friendly resources.
## Features
Explore the core capabilities of the GetResponse platform for customer engagement, marketing automation, ecommerce and business growth.
- [All Features](https://www.getresponse.com/features): Overview of all GetResponse capabilities, including AI-powered tools, email marketing, automation, ecommerce, webinars, websites and analytics.
- [Email Marketing](https://www.getresponse.com/features/email-marketing): Create, personalize and optimize email campaigns with a drag-and-drop editor, templates and AI-powered assistance.
- [AI Email Generator](https://www.getresponse.com/features/email-marketing/ai-email-generator): Generate engaging marketing emails with AI tailored to your industry and campaign goals.
- [AI Campaign Generator](https://www.getresponse.com/features/ai-campaign-generator): Get a custom landing page, welcome email, and newsletter generated with the power of OpenAI technology.
- [Marketing Automation](https://www.getresponse.com/features/marketing-automation): Build automated customer journeys using visual workflows, triggers and multichannel communication.
- [Autoresponders](https://www.getresponse.com/features/email-marketing/autoresponder): Automatically send personalized email sequences based on time or customer actions.
- [Landing Page Builder](https://www.getresponse.com/features/landing-page-creator): Build AI-assisted landing pages with drag-and-drop editing, A/B testing and lead generation tools.
- [Website Builder](https://www.getresponse.com/features/website-builder): Create complete websites using AI, customizable templates and integrated marketing tools.
- [Popups](https://www.getresponse.com/features/popup-creator): Capture leads using embedded forms, popups and behavioral targeting.
- [Web Push Notifications](https://www.getresponse.com/features/web-push-notifications): Re-engage visitors with browser push notifications and automated campaigns.
- [SMS Marketing Automation Tool](https://www.getresponse.com/features/sms-text-automation): Reach customers with promotional and transactional SMS campaigns.
- [Live Chats](https://www.getresponse.com/features/live-chat): Engage website visitors in real time with embedded live chat.
- [Webinars](https://www.getresponse.com/features/webinar-software): Host live webinars integrated with registration, email marketing and automation.
- [Conversion Funnels](https://www.getresponse.com/features/conversion-funnel): Create end-to-end marketing and sales funnels combining landing pages, email marketing and ecommerce.
- [Course Builder](https://www.getresponse.com/features/course-creator): Create and deliver online courses with AI assistance, quizzes and certificates.
- [Paid Ads](https://www.getresponse.com/features/paid-ads): Create and manage Meta Ads and Google Ads from within GetResponse.
- [Product Recommendations](https://www.getresponse.com/features/product-recommendations): Personalize your website's shopping experience and email campaigns with automated,AI-based product recommendations.
- [Signup Forms](https://www.getresponse.com/features/list-building/form-builder): Create embedded signup forms to capture leads and grow your email list.
## Solutions
Discover how GetResponse helps businesses solve specific marketing and growth challenges across different industries and business models.
- [Lead Generation](https://www.getresponse.com/solutions/lead-generation-software): Generate, qualify and nurture leads using landing pages, signup forms, popups, email marketing, automation and paid ads to turn anonymous visitors into customers.
- [Customer Engagement](https://www.getresponse.com/solutions/customer-engagement): Build lasting customer relationships through personalized email marketing, marketing automation, SMS, web push notifications, webinars and multichannel communication.
- [Ecommerce Marketing](https://www.getresponse.com/solutions/ecommerce-marketing): Increase online sales with ecommerce integrations, abandoned cart recovery, AI product recommendations, promo codes, customer segmentation and multichannel automation.
- [Affiliate Marketing](https://www.getresponse.com/solutions/affiliate-marketing): Grow affiliate businesses with lead generation, landing pages, automation, AI-powered campaigns, webinars, ecommerce tools and performance analytics.
- [Knowledge Commerce](https://www.getresponse.com/solutions/selling-knowledge): Monetize expertise by selling online courses, premium newsletters and webinars while growing an audience with AI-powered marketing and automation.
## GetResponse MAX
Enterprise solutions for organizations that require advanced marketing capabilities, dedicated infrastructure, premium support and tailored onboarding.
- [GetResponse MAX](https://www.getresponse.com/max): Enterprise-grade marketing platform with advanced email marketing, multichannel automation, AI-powered lead generation, dedicated infrastructure, premium support and tailored solutions for global organizations.
## Integrations
Connect GetResponse with over 170 native integrations across ecommerce, CRM, CMS, payments and business tools. The integrations below highlight some of the most widely used platforms.
- [Integrations Directory](https://www.getresponse.com/integrations): Browse the complete catalog of 170+ native integrations and integration partners for ecommerce, CRM, CMS, payments, analytics and marketing automation.
- [Shopify](https://www.getresponse.com/integrations/shopify.html): Sync customers, products and orders to power ecommerce marketing and automation.
- [WooCommerce](https://www.getresponse.com/integrations/woocommerce.html): Connect WooCommerce stores to synchronize ecommerce data and personalize marketing campaigns.
- [Magento](https://www.getresponse.com/integrations/magento.html): Integrate Magento stores to automate marketing using customer and order data.
- [PrestaShop](https://www.getresponse.com/integrations/prestashop.html): Synchronize PrestaShop customers and products for ecommerce marketing and automation.
- [BigCommerce](https://www.getresponse.com/integrations/bigcommerce.html): Connect BigCommerce stores to drive personalized campaigns and customer engagement.
- [Shoper](https://www.getresponse.com/integrations/shoper.html): Integrate Shoper stores to synchronize customer data and automate ecommerce communication.
- [IdoSell](https://www.getresponse.com/integrations/idosell.html): Connect IdoSell ecommerce stores with GetResponse to automate customer communication and marketing.
- [WordPress](https://www.getresponse.com/integrations/wordpress.html): Capture leads, embed forms and connect WordPress websites with GetResponse.
- [Salesforce](https://www.getresponse.com/integrations/salesforce-data-synchronization.html): Keep CRM contacts synchronized and align sales and marketing processes.
- [HubSpot](https://www.getresponse.com/integrations/hubspot.html): Synchronize contacts and marketing data between HubSpot and GetResponse.
- [Stripe](https://www.getresponse.com/integrations/stripe.html): Accept payments and automate marketing workflows based on customer purchases.
- [PayPal](https://www.getresponse.com/integrations/paypal.html): Trigger marketing automation and customer journeys using PayPal transaction data.
- [PayU](https://www.getresponse.com/integrations/payu.html): Connect PayU payments with GetResponse to automate post-purchase communication.
## Pricing
Information about plans, pricing and billing.
- [Pricing](https://www.getresponse.com/pricing): Available plans, included features, pricing and subscription details.
## SDKs
Official client libraries and developer resources.
- [GetResponse GitHub](https://github.com/GetResponse): Official GitHub organization containing SDKs, integrations and developer resources.
- [PHP SDK](https://github.com/GetResponse/sdk-php): Official PHP SDK for integrating with the GetResponse REST API.
- [Flutter Mobile SDK](https://github.com/GetResponse/MobileSDK-Flutter): Flutter SDK for integrating GetResponse Mobile Push notifications into Flutter applications using Firebase Cloud Messaging.
- [Android Mobile SDK](https://github.com/GetResponse/MobileSDK-Android): Native Android SDK for integrating GetResponse Mobile Push notifications into Android applications.
- [iOS Mobile SDK](https://github.com/GetResponse/MobileSDK-IOS): Native iOS SDK for integrating GetResponse Mobile Push notifications into iOS applications.
- [Magento Integration](https://github.com/GetResponse/magento): Official Magento extension for synchronizing contacts, products and ecommerce data with GetResponse, including abandoned cart recovery and marketing automation support.
- [PrestaShop Integration](https://github.com/GetResponse/GetresponseForPrestashop): Official PrestaShop integration for synchronizing contacts, products and ecommerce data with GetResponse to power ecommerce marketing and automation.
## API Documentation
Reference documentation for integrating with the GetResponse REST API.
- [API Guides](https://apidocs.getresponse.com/v3): Getting started, authentication, concepts, guides and integration examples.
- [OpenAPI Specification](https://apireference.getresponse.com/open-api.json): Machine-readable OpenAPI specification describing all REST API endpoints, operations, request and response schemas.
- [Agent Skills](https://github.com/GetResponse/public-api-agent-skills): Reusable Agent Skills that help AI agents understand and interact with the GetResponse Public API using best practices and reusable workflows.
## Help Center
Documentation explaining product features and workflows.
- [Help Center](https://www.getresponse.com/help): Browse all product documentation, tutorials and troubleshooting articles.
- [What is GetResponse and how to use it?](https://www.getresponse.com/help/what-is-getresponse-and-how-can-i-use-it.html): Overview of the GetResponse platform, its core capabilities and how to get started.
- [How to create and send a newsletter?](https://www.getresponse.com/help/how-to-create-and-send-a-newsletter.html): Learn how to create, customize and send email newsletters.
- [How to import a list of contacts?](https://www.getresponse.com/help/how-can-i-import-a-list-of-contacts.html): Import contacts into GetResponse and prepare your audience for email marketing.
- [What is a segment and how to create one?](https://www.getresponse.com/help/what-is-a-segment.html): Create dynamic contact segments for targeted communication.
- [How does a marketing automation message work?](https://www.getresponse.com/help/how-does-a-marketing-automation-message-work.html): Learn how automation messages work within marketing automation workflows, how they differ from newsletters and autoresponders, and how to create, reuse and manage them.
- [What is Conversion Funnel?](https://www.getresponse.com/help/what-is-conversion-funnel.html): Learn how Conversion Funnel combines landing pages, email marketing and ecommerce into a complete sales workflow.
- [How is Conversion Funnel different from Marketing Automation?](https://www.getresponse.com/help/how-is-conversion-funnel-different-from-marketing-automation.html): Understand the differences between Conversion Funnel and Marketing Automation and when to use each feature.
- [What is a landing page and why do I need one?](https://www.getresponse.com/help/what-is-a-landing-page-and-why-do-i-need-one.html): Learn how landing pages help capture leads and improve campaign conversions.
- [What are GetResponse Webinars?](https://www.getresponse.com/help/what-are-getresponse-webinars.html): Overview of the webinar platform and its capabilities for audience engagement.
- [How to create a Web push notification?](https://www.getresponse.com/help/how-to-create-a-web-push-notification.html): Create and send web push notifications as part of multichannel marketing campaigns.
- [How to set up SMS marketing in the USA and Canada?](https://www.getresponse.com/help/how-to-set-up-sms-marketing-in-the-usa-and-canada.html): Configure and use SMS marketing as an additional communication channel.
- [How to upload my product data to GetResponse?](https://www.getresponse.com/help/how-can-i-upload-my-product-data-to-getresponse.html): Import product catalog data to power ecommerce marketing and automation.
- [Can I segment my contacts based on ecommerce data?](https://www.getresponse.com/help/can-i-segment-my-contacts-based-on-ecommerce-data.html): Use ecommerce events and purchase history for advanced audience segmentation.

Frequently asked questions
How long are your contracts? 
GetResponse offers you two billing periods: monthly or 12 months. We also offer a 14-day Free trial account. For the first 14 days of using it, you will have trial access to the premium features of our platform. You can upgrade your Free account to a paid one at any time. 
Please note that after the first 14 days, you lose access to the premium features.
With the 
Enterprise
 plan, you can choose between three billing periods: monthly, 12 months and 24 months.
What features can I try during the 14-day trial? 
On the first 14 days of using your Free account, we give you access to the premium features of GetResponse. There are some limitations on the Free account regarding webinars, messages, landing pages, marketing automation, and chats. 
 
 
AI course creator
: You can create an unlimited number of courses for up to 250 students but selling them is available in the paid plan only.
 
Premium newsletters
: You can create an unlimited number of premium newsletters with free subscription but paid subscriptions are available in the paid plan only.
 
Webinars
: Recordings and on-demand webinars, limited to 10 people (including you and presenters).
 
Messages
: The GetResponse badge will be added to every message you send from the Free account. Disabling the badge is possible if you upgrade to a paid account. 
 
Landing pages
: You can create and publish as many landing pages as you want, but the visits are limited to 1,000 unique visitors per month. Unlimited visits and tools like AB testing are available in paid plans only. 
 
Marketing automation
: You can create and publish as many workflows as you want. Dynamic segment filter is not available. You can unlock it with any paid plan.
 
Contacting Customer Success Team
: You can reach our support team via live chat in English (7 AM–11 PM, weekends 7 AM–9 PM, GMT+1) and Polish (Mon–Fri, 9 AM–5 PM). A chatbot is available 24/7 in all languages, and email support is available 24/7 in English, Polish, German, Spanish, Portuguese, French, or Italian.
 
If you are interested in the 
Enterprise
 plan, you can take advantage of the Pilot Program, which allows you to test the Enterprise tools for 30 days. To take advantage of the Pilot Program, simply book a demo to discuss the details with our expert, who will provide you with access to the platform. The Pilot Program is an advanced form of testing our tools. You will also receive support from our experts - we want customers to experience what it's like to work with the GetResponse team.
What we offer:
30-day access to the platform and its features
Dedicated support
Ideas for your marketing automation strategy
What happens after the 14-day trial period? 
You will lose access to premium features if you don’t upgrade. You’ll still be able to log in to your account and use the free version of GetResponse. 
Read this article
 to see what limitations your account will have if you don’t upgrade after the first 14 days from the moment you set up your free account.
How can I buy GetResponse? 
You can purchase one of the available plans directly from this page and, in the case of the Enterprise plan, book a free demo. Once you verify your account, you can test all the features free of charge for 14 days. To upgrade your free account to one of the paid plans, follow these simple steps:
 
 
 Log in to your account. In the Profile menu, click Upgrade account.
 
 Choose the plan from Starter, Marketer, and Creator and select the package (list size). 
 
 Enter your account details and payment information. 
 
 Choose your subscription plan: standard plan billed monthly (every month) or 12-month prepay with 18% discount. 
 
 Click the Upgrade Account button.
 
 
If you are interested in the Enterprise plan, click on the 'Book a demo' button. Our expert will contact you to discuss your business, challenges, goals, and expectations and create a proposal tailored to your business needs.
Which pricing plan should I choose? 
There are three standard plans, each of them with its own add-on availability and included features. All plans include options for the list sizes: 1k, 2.5k, 5k, 10k, 25k, 50k, and 100k.
An 
Enterprise Plan
 with advanced solutions and a personalized quote is also available. It includes all the tools and features of the above plans plus SMS marketing, AI product recommendations, and mobile push notifications.
Starter
 – Enables a powerful start into list building and AI-powered email marketing. Every account created within this package allows for 3 users, provides access to ecommerce integrations, and includes 1 automation workflow. AI tool
